alias: Hub screen brightness follows the day
description: 100 % while the sun is up, 60 % in the evening and early morning, 20 % from 22:00 to 06:00. Sets the level only, so a sleeping screen stays asleep.

data.value: {% if is_state('sun.sun', 'above_horizon') %}100{% elif now().hour >= 22 or now().hour < 6 %}20{% else %}60{% endif %}
